title: LegalDocument
description: A versioned Vietnamese legal or administrative instrument with full temporal and relationship metadata.
_required_note: document_number, issuing_authority and issue_date were required until ADR-0004. They are not universally knowable from source: issue_date is absent on records discovered via listing pages but never fetched, document_number on records whose page title carries no parseable number, and issuing_authority is only derivable as a raw code (see issuing_authority_code). Requiring them truncated the corpus rather than improving it.

document_type.description: Canonical English vocabulary. schema.prisma mirrors these as Vietnamese slugs (circular=thong_tu, decree=nghi_dinh, consolidated-document=van_ban_hop_nhat, ...); this list is authoritative per ADR-0002.

document_type_basis.description: How document_type was derived. The Vietnamese title prefix names the type; the number suffix names the issuing body. Orthogonal signals, so the prefix is authoritative.

document_number_raw.description: Unparsed number token, kept when it failed validation rather than guessed at (e.g. 'số', 'TC/QÐ/TCCB').

issuing_authority_code.description: Verbatim body token from the document number, e.g. 'TT-BYT'. Not resolved to a display name: 1,106 distinct tokens exist and the 30 most common cover only 80% of records.

subject_slug.description: The document's topic, de-diacriticized, from the source URL. `title` on this corpus is a citation ('Thông tư 28/2026/TT-BYT của Bộ Y tế') and carries no subject matter.

fetch_status.description: 'discovered' = found on a listing page but the detail page was never retrieved; such records have a title but no dates and no body.

effective_to.description: Expiry/repeal date; null while in force.

version.description: VNKC record version; increments on every change, never overwrites.

legal_basis.description: Citations of instruments this one is based on (căn cứ).

guides.description: Canonical IDs of instruments this one guides the implementation of (hướng dẫn thi hành).
